newsitem.title: FINLAND: ILKKA SEES LOWER 1997 NET SALES.
newsitem.headline: ILKKA SEES LOWER 1997 NET SALES.

text.p: Finnish media group Ilkka Oy said on Tuesday it expected its net sales to fall in 1997 on 1996 due to lower volumes of securities trading.

"The group's net sales are expected to fall compared to 1996 mainly due to a lower volume in securities trading," Ilkka said in a statement with its 1996 report, which showed net sales of 235 million markka, up from 212 million in 1995.
Ilkka said the start-up of its new printing plant would weigh on its 1997 performance.
"The decline of net interest income due to the financing of the new newspaper printing plant will also weigh on 1997 earnings," it said.
Ilkka's 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax was 32.8 million markka, down from 36.9 million in 1995.
